name: Witnesses
overview: Scripture emphasizes the importance of multiple witnesses to establish truth, as seen in Deuteronomy 19:15, which requires two or three witnesses to confirm a matter. Matthew 18:15 teaches the need for personal and direct confrontation in addressing sin within the community. Believers are called to demonstrate their discipleship through love for one another, a powerful testimony to the world according to John 13:35. Hebrews 12:1 reminds Christians that they are surrounded by a great cloud of witnesses, encouraging perseverance and faithfulness in their spiritual journey.
